fields.label: Default
fields.description: Default gateway for this currency; at most one enabled gateway per currency.

fields.label: Max Silent Charge
fields.description: Largest amount this gateway may pull off-session in this currency. Empty means no ceiling. INR is held at ₹15,000 by the RBI rule, whichever gateway it is.

fields.label: Requires Pre-Debit Notice
fields.description: Notify the customer before every off-session debit on this rail.
